summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of Aurora F&B ERP - Torado Group Loyalty Portal UI Redesign. All features tested and working correctly. The redesigned loyalty portal successfully implements the dark premium theme with glassmorphism, warm espresso background (#0D0B07), gold accents (#C9A876), and Cormorant Garamond fonts. Login functionality verified with test credentials, all pages accessible and properly styled.
passed_tests: Public Homepage Header - Torado Rewards button visible and prominent in navigation
ERP Login Page - Minimal design with 'Aurora ERP — Staff Portal' label and 'Bergabung Loyalty Program' link
Loyalty Login Page - Split-screen layout with brand panel (left) and form panel (right), email/password inputs, Masuk button, subtle Staff Access link
Loyalty Login - Successfully logged in with test.member@torado.id / Torado@2026 and redirected to /loyalty dashboard

Loyalty Dashboard - Bento grid layout with points hero card (0 points, BRONZE tier), tier progress bar, 4 quick action cards (Kartu Digital, Tukar Rewards, Riwayat Poin, Profile Saya), Recent Transactions section, Referral code card (TORA-R22H)
Loyalty Dashboard - Header with TORADO Rewards logo and points chip displaying correctly
Loyalty Card Page - Digital card with QR code, tier gradient (Bronze), card number (TORA-BC4D-0F37), Back to Dashboard button
Loyalty Rewards Page - Category filter tabs (Semua, Voucher, Pengalaman, Merchandise), reward grid with cards, search input, points required displayed
Loyalty History Page - Stats cards (Total Poin, Didapat, Ditukar), transaction list with filters (Semua, Diterima, Ditukar)
Loyalty Profile Page - Profile form with fields (full_name, phone, date_of_birth), Password change form with 3 fields (current, new, confirm), Save and Change Password buttons
Loyalty Register Page - Split-screen layout with form fields (full_name, email, phone, password, confirm_password), Daftar Sekarang button
